integrity: The supplied source checks the complete size-independent capped/tagged factor; direct independent implementation checks six finite labelled graph instances. No claim of mechanised or independent certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Only deterministic synchronous three-color threshold-two cyclic cellular automata on labelled complete tripartite simple graphs with all parts nonempty; other graph classes, colour counts, thresholds and update schedules are not covered. Originality is bounded by identified indexed and full-text literature; an unindexed equivalent cannot be excluded. The finite exhaustive lemma has not received an independent external audit.
title: A sharp period-spectrum trichotomy for threshold-two cyclic competition on tripartite graphs
